spec_schema_drift_dirs_context: Directories tree-SHA-diffed between the latest stable spec tag and main, so the watcher reports WHICH files moved rather than only that a version shipped. Scoped to what a signals-only agent can be graded on: the signals request/response schemas, the shared core + protocol schemas they $ref, the signals scenario storyboards, and the universal storyboards every agent runs. Deliberately excludes media-buy / creative / brand / governance dirs — churn there is constant and cannot affect us. Reported drift is NOT automatically a problem: core/targeting.json and the universal contract docs change often for media-buy reasons. The watcher surfaces; a human judges.

OURS (filed 2026-08-06T21:19Z from the sales-agent session): runner UX — a schema-invalid get_adcp_capabilities response surfaces as N unrelated track failures instead of one root cause; two documented repros (#6242 account block, #6206 correlation_id). bokelley triaged ready-to-implement, P1, Spec Backlog, with a TWO-PART fix: Part A (this repo) = add canonical notice code `capabilities_response_schema_invalid` to static/compliance/source/universal/runner-output-contract.yaml canonical_codes (~line 1083), patch-eligible, no changeset; Part B (adcp-client) = pre-execution capabilities validation in the SDK runner emitting that notice, no suppression of downstream failures, no 'affects N storyboards' aggregation in v1. WE OFFERED TO TAKE PART A and asked one blocking design question (comment 5209623017, 2026-08-06T22:0xZ): the triage specifies an RFC 6901 `capability_path`, but the contract defines that field as a DOTTED path and all three canonical codes carrying it are dotted — options are (1) dotted, (2) new optional `capability_pointer` alongside it [our recommendation], (3) redefine to accept either. FIRES ON HIS ANSWER: that unblocks our PR. Do not conflate with #6206 under the same notice code (his explicit instruction). Drop after Part A merges.

bokelley's '[codex] Add measurement gateway feedback contract' draft (2026-08-06, 24 files, CONFLICTING, zero reviews). WHY WE WATCH IT: it functionally SUPERSEDES our still-open RFC #4296 (Measurement Feedback Signal, milestone 3.3.0) — same four schema files, and it delivers the exact apply-confirmation gate bokelley's 2026-05-09 triage said must land before any WG vote on MeasurementFeedbackSignal scope — while citing #4296 as a bare 'Related:' link, naming us nowhere, and dropping 7 of our asks (nested feedback-signal object, signal_agent_segment_id/signal-grain gate, governance_check_id, FEEDBACK_SUPERSEDED, our single measurement.feedback capability key, the causal vocabulary). Zero signals-domain impact — this is a POSITIONAL watch, not a technical one. Fires on ready-for-review, reviews, comments, merge, or close. If we choose to engage, the surface is the spec's five open WG questions plus two technical hooks: core/performance-feedback.json deletes published properties (feedback_id/status/submitted_at/applied_at) under a `minor` changeset without the Compatibility section addressing it, and our 'confidence_interval implies sample_size required' conditional is dropped. Drop when it merges/closes and we've decided whether to respond on #4296.

OURS (filed 2026-08-07). $build_assets_from_format (v3.1.11, PR #6258 backporting #6244) makes the runner build the sync_creatives manifest from the seller's own declared required slots, but adcp-client's creative-assets.ts buildAsset only covers image/url/text — any required slot of type video/audio/html/javascript/vast_tag/vendor is unbuildable, the step fails PRE-TRANSPORT, and the agent is graded down for a harness limitation. storyboard-schema.yaml:2314-2316 says such halts are 'a conformance bug on the runner side, not a grading signal about the agent', and its own preflight-point-1 already prescribes not_applicable — which is the ask. Three more: the normative text at :651-652 names only image+URL as fillable though the runner also does text (implementers can't predict gradeability); buildImage requires EXACT dimension match against only 5 acme-outdoor fixtures (300x250, 728x90, 320x50, 160x600, 1200x628 — so 970x250, 300x600, 336x280, 1080x1920 all fail); and buildText picks content by substring-matching the slot id for headline/description/cta with a headlines fallback, so a required disclaimer/legal/alt_text slot silently receives a marketing headline — a FALSE PASS risk mirroring the false fail. Fires on triage/labels/comments/close. NOTE: found via the sales agent's 3.1.11 degrade, but that agent has its own separate defect (its list_creative_formats publishes slots primary/click_url/alt_text while its sync_creatives takes flat image_url/click_url/alt_text) — do not conflate. Drop when triaged and resolved.

OURS (filed 2026-08-07 at bokelley's explicit request on adcp#6267). THE critical path to un-degrading the sales agent badge: $build_assets_from_format reaches validateRequest unexpanded on the path AAO's grader takes, so sync_creatives is rejected at the runner's OUTBOUND validation and the agent never receives a request — 5 media_buy phases lost, reproduced on 4 consecutive grades (14:02/14:31/18:48/19:31Z 08-07), identical counts. bokelley triaged adcp#6267 P0, spec-repo change NOT needed. KEY VERIFIED FINDING we contributed: in published @adcp/sdk@13.0.0-rc.8 the expansion lives in dist/lib/testing/storyboard/creative-assets.* while validateRequest lives in dist/lib/core/SingleAgentClient.*, and `build_assets_from_format` appears NOWHERE in SingleAgentClient — so this is TWO ENTRY POINTS with different guarantees, not one inverted sequence; runner.ts already expands (~4109) then takes a SKIP branch on unresolved (~4121). Reordering the runner alone would leave the grader unchanged. Second ask in the issue: prefer skip over hard-fail for any unbuildable case (the {{runner.*}} family already skips), otherwise fixing ordering just moves which sellers are wrongly graded — creative-assets buildAsset covers only image/url/text. Fires on comments, labels, close, or a linked PR. Drop when a fix ships in an @adcp/sdk release AND the sales agent regrades clean. Companion: adcp#6269 (the contract ambiguity, WG must resolve), adcp#6267 (spec-repo parent).

external_registries.context: AAO official agent registry (https://agenticadvertising.org/registry/). Fires when agents are added, removed, or rename. Identity = agent URL (stable across renames; surfaces show the new name in the diff). Primary value: catch new ecosystem entrants without manual checks. As of 2026-05-04 the registry has 21 entries; we federate with ~6 of them via /agents/registry — when new agents appear we may want to add them to our local directory.
